# VirtualContainerOptions Interface

> [!CAUTION]
> This interface is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

Options for creating a virtual container with VirtualContainerManager.create. The size sets its number of slots, from 1 to 54, which its screen lays out nine per row. The optional title is the heading on its screen, which is empty by default. A title can be up to 256 bytes and is localized when it names a localization key, in which case the limit applies to the key rather than the localized text. Neither can be changed once the container is created.

## Properties

### **size**
`size: number;`

The number of slots in the container, from 1 to 54. The screen lays them out nine per row.

Type: *number*

### **title**
`title?: string;`

The heading shown on the container screen, up to 256 bytes. It is localized when it names a localization key. Defaults to no heading.

Type: *string*
